card.title: I Started the Weirdness
card.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The cups are floating. I'll tie them down while you rescue breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You flicked that gravity switch reaching for the toaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could've been the toaster. Give me the string; I'll secure everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole table's rising. Hold my ankles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got you. I'll anchor us to the radiator. Let's list what floated, not who touched what.
